title: In the Shadow of Your Wings

request.style: English, emotional female solo voice, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, light percussion, warm and hopeful mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I fled the king into a hidden cave
My heart was heavy with the weight of fear
I hide myself within this narrow place
And cry out loud for you to draw near

[Pre-Chorus]
I call to God Most High who rules above
To God who fulfills his purpose for me

[Chorus]
Have mercy on me O God have mercy on me
For in you my soul takes refuge
In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge
Until the destroying storms pass by

[Verse]
He sends from heaven and saves me today
He rebukes the one who tramples me down
Steadfast love and faithfulness come my way
To protect me in this sacred ground

[Pre-Chorus]
I call to God Most High who rules above
To God who fulfills his purpose for me

[Chorus]
Have mercy on me O God have mercy on me
For in you my soul takes refuge
In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge
Until the destroying storms pass by

[Bridge]
My soul lies down among wild lions
Breathing out fire and sharp teeth
But your arms are wider than their claws
And your voice is strong and sweet

[Chorus]
Have mercy on me O God have mercy on me
For in you my soul takes refuge
In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge
Until the destroying storms pass by

[Outro]
Until the destroying storms pass by
My soul is safe beneath your wings
